title: Review round 1: kith-tslocal Tailscale LocalAPI client
notes:
Confidence: 80% chance of missed bug. P0=0 P1=3 P2=2 after opinion filter. Are we running out of real complaints: YES.

Remaining actionable P1: KITH-626.1 (hyper pin undocumented), KITH-626.2 (hyper semi-internal API stability note), KITH-626.6 (magic constants need security rationale).
Remaining actionable P2: KITH-626.24 (test socket cleanup not RAII — real test fragility), KITH-626.26 (null-byte check missing security rationale comment).

Opinion-labeled (22 items): All 'decision' type P2s (describing correct existing behavior, not issues), all P3/P4 style/readability items, KITH-626.10 (error prefix inconsistency — purely cosmetic, no incorrect behavior), KITH-626.22 (mock server hyper change concern — speculative, raw HTTP/1.1 parsing is not a regression risk).

Assessment: The 5 remaining findings are real engineering issues, not noise. All are documentation/comment improvements that prevent future maintainer mistakes or fix test fragility. None represent a missed functional bug or security gap. The review has genuinely run out of real complaints about the implementation logic — what remains is all in the 'make it easier to maintain correctly' category.
